instruction: Candid outdoor medium-full photograph of a couple walking on a dirt path in a sunny park. On the left, the woman in the long black coat (R1) walks forward in blue jeans, her head turned to her right. On the right, the man in the black puffer jacket (R2) walks beside her, looking down. They hold hands, walking in unison. The background shows sunlit trees and a park bench. Warm, direct sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the ground.
